title: A substructural logic for quantum measurements
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It is a theoretical paper on logic for quantum mechanics.
findings: The paper presents a substructural logic for quantum measurements and does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
